analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($147.12) vs SMA5/20/50 ($150.04/$152.34/$144.87): Below short/mid-term trends, indicating weakness.
· Position vs SMA100/200 ($139.69/$126.06): Above long-term trends, maintaining strength.
· 52-week position (83.7%) + Current price range near historical highs.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (50.4 → 47.1): Entering oversold, downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.7632 → -0.8450): Worsening, weak trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Lower band $146.74): Approaching lower band, 7.35% band width suggests potential for increased volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($137.52): Potential for further decline if Pivot S1 ($143.14) is breached.
· Swing resistance ($147.87): Short-term rebound expected on breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Potential Lower High): Weakening signal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.75x): Reduced confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): Maintaining a wait-and-see approach; cautious about entering long due to RSI entering oversold and MACD continuing to worsen.
